meta.name: searxng
meta.description: Privacy-respecting metasearch using your local SearXNG instance. Search the web, images, news, and more without external API dependencies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用本地搜索引擎私密搜索网页、图片和新闻
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望用自建搜索引擎保护搜索隐私
copy.tagline_en: Search the web, images, and news privately with your local SearXNG instance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to protect your search privacy with a self-hosted metasearch engine

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过你的本地 SearXNG 实例搜索网页、图片、新闻、视频等，返回结果列表。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 搜索信息、查找资料或询问某个问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索一下最近的科技新闻。
say.note: Claude 会调用 SearXNG 搜索新闻类别。

say.text: 找几张关于猫咪的图片。
搜索“气候变化”的最新文章。
say.note: Claude 会返回网页搜索结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search the web, images, news, and videos using your local SearXNG instance and return result lists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to search for information, look up something, or find data.

say_en.text: Search for the latest tech news.
say_en.note: Claude will search the news category.
Claude will search the images category.

say_en.text: Search for recent articles on climate change.
say_en.note: Claude will return web search results.
